notes: 184 redirect sources loaded from staged-changes/redirect-backups (union of 8/28 exports). The 2026-09-14 sweep added ~58 more 301s (21 grade posts, 25-page 2021-22 Renewal tree, 12 staff working copies) that may not all be in these exports; re-check against the live Redirection list before indexing pages.

cfa-website src/content/posts/ is the migrated Center & Periphery archive (2010→); it overlaps the WordPress posts export by slug. Dedupe on slug and prefer the cfa-website copy. The Fall 2026 issue (7 articles, Elsy-reviewed) is on branch cp-fall-2026, not yet on main - index it once merged.
board: intentionally empty. CfA supplies minutes/bylaws; nothing indexed at board without David.
finance is limited to the two folders named in the brief; the HolyOps shared-drive P&L workbooks are NOT listed here because they live in Milan's Drive and should be his call.

Pages carry retired=true when their URL is a 301 source in our redirect exports or the title reads as a copy/draft/old page. Recommend indexing retired=false pages only; retired ones pollute answers with stale dates.
